title: Labari
description: A public watch on what is changing in AI, read from Softanza's point of view.

items.title: Labari opens: a public watch on AI, read from Softanza's point of view
items.summary: Softanza opened Labari, a public repository that reads developments in AI at their source and judges each one against what Softanza builds. Every entry is written twice in one file, as a page for people and as data for programs, and a feed is generated from the data.
